mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, manager_id, parent_id, type, user_count, created_at, updated_at FROM department ORDER BY name ASC
SELECT id, name, description, manager_id, parent_id, type, user_count, created_at, updated_at FROM department WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO department (name, description, manager_id, parent_id, type, user_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{managerId}, #{parentId}, #{type}, #{userCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, phone, full_name, department_id, role, active, created_at, updated_at FROM user WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, username, email, phone, full_name, department_id, role, active, created_at, updated_at FROM user WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE department SET user_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE department_id = #{departmentId}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{departmentId}
